title: DescriptorMetadata
description: Free-form string key/value metadata attached to a descriptor. Keys are compared case-insensitively and must be unique; values must be strings or null.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: use `metadata` for tooling or documentation annotations such as `owner`, `generatedBy`, or `ticket`. The runtime does not interpret metadata; it is merged across model layers and preserved by the designer. Do not store structured data here; values must be plain strings or null.
